A_r7.note: current R7 production SQL (captured from the builder)
A_r7.sql:
select "id" from "page_revisions" where ("page_revisions"."created_at" < $1 and (select count(*) from (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" newer
        where newer.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and (newer.version, newer.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit $2
      ) newer_rows) = $3 and not ("page_revisions"."kind" = 'publish' and not exists (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" published
        where published.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and published.kind = 'publish'
          and (published.version, published.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit 1))) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $4

H_fenced_guarded.note: B_fenced + uncorrelated EXISTS(group by parent having count(*) > k) guard as a One-Time Filter; exact R7 probes stay the eligibility test
H_fenced_guarded.sql:
select "id" from "page_revisions" where (exists (select 1 from "page_revisions" guard_parents group by guard_parents.page_id having count(*) > $1) and ("page_revisions"."page_id" = any(array(select candidate_parents.page_id from "page_revisions" candidate_parents group by candidate_parents.page_id having count(*) > $2))) is true and "page_revisions"."created_at" < $3 and (select count(*) from (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" newer
        where newer.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and (newer.version, newer.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit $4
      ) newer_rows) = $5 and not ("page_revisions"."kind" = 'publish' and not exists (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" published
        where published.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and published.kind = 'publish'
          and (published.version, published.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit 1))) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $6

G_adaptive.note: adaptive: materialized S aggregate; window over S partitions when 1 <= rows(S) <= 20,000; fenced retention walk + R7 probes when rows(S) > 20,000; nothing when S is empty
G_adaptive.sql:
select "id" from "page_revisions" where "page_revisions"."id" = any(array(with candidate_parents as materialized (select cp.page_id, count(*) as parent_rows from "page_revisions" cp group by cp.page_id having count(*) > $1), candidate_stats as materialized (select coalesce(sum(parent_rows), 0) as total_rows, array_agg(page_id) as parent_ids from candidate_parents) select branch.id from ((select ranked.id, ranked.created_at from (select r.id, r.created_at, r.kind, row_number() over newest as newer_rank, count(*) filter (where r.kind = 'publish') over (newest rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding) as newer_publishes from "page_revisions" r where r.page_id = any((select parent_ids from candidate_stats)::uuid[]) window newest as (partition by r.page_id order by r.version desc, r.id desc)) ranked where (select total_rows from candidate_stats) between 1 and $2 and ranked.created_at < $3 and ranked.newer_rank > $4 and not (ranked.kind = 'publish' and ranked.newer_publishes = 0) order by ranked.created_at asc, ranked.id asc limit $5) union all (select "page_revisions"."id", "page_revisions"."created_at" from "page_revisions" where ((select total_rows from candidate_stats) > $6 and ("page_revisions"."page_id" = any((select parent_ids from candidate_stats)::uuid[])) is true and "page_revisions"."created_at" < $7 and (select count(*) from (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" newer
        where newer.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and (newer.version, newer.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit $8
      ) newer_rows) = $9 and not ("page_revisions"."kind" = 'publish' and not exists (
        select 1 from "page_revisions" published
        where published.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id"
          and published.kind = 'publish'
          and (published.version, published.id) > ("page_revisions"."version", "page_revisions"."id")
        limit 1))) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $10)) branch order by branch.created_at asc, branch.id asc limit $11)) order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $12

F_floor_join.note: per-parent floor version (offset k) + newest-publish anchor id computed once (loose parent scan + two LIMIT-1 index probes per parent), hash-joined to the ordered retention_idx walk; no correlated probes
F_floor_join.sql: with recursive parents as ((select p.page_id from "page_revisions" p order by p.page_id limit 1) union all select (select p.page_id from "page_revisions" p where p.page_id > parents.page_id order by p.page_id limit 1) from parents where parents.page_id is not null), floors as materialized (select parents.page_id, floor_row.version as floor_version, anchor_row.id as anchor_id from parents cross join lateral (select f.version from "page_revisions" f where f.page_id = parents.page_id order by f.version desc offset $1 limit 1) floor_row left join lateral (select a.id from "page_revisions" a where a.page_id = parents.page_id and a.kind = 'publish' order by a.version desc, a.id desc limit 1) anchor_row on true where parents.page_id is not null) select "page_revisions"."id" from "page_revisions" inner join floors on floors.page_id = "page_revisions"."page_id" where "page_revisions"."created_at" < $2 and "page_revisions"."version" <= floors.floor_version and "page_revisions"."id" is distinct from floors.anchor_id order by "page_revisions"."created_at" asc, "page_revisions"."id" asc limit $3
